questions.q: When you are hurting, which of the video's questions do you ask God most?
questions.answer: One honest example: "Am I alone in this?" The video's answer is that God isn't distant; in Jesus He came down and suffered right alongside us.

questions.q: How did the lepers see Father Damien differently once he said "we lepers"?
questions.answer: They already knew he loved them, but now he was one of them. He understood their pain from the inside, and they saw how much he had given up for them.

questions.q: Does knowing Jesus felt betrayal and physical pain change how you pray?
questions.answer: It can. I can be honest with God about pain or being let down, because Jesus was betrayed by one of His closest disciples and suffered on the cross. He understands.
